senses.gloss:
शो {c4c} P. (श्यति, शात or शित, pass.
[]
शायते; caus. शाययति; desid. शिशासातं)
1 To sharpen, whet.
--2 To make
thin, attenuate.

सो {c4c} P. (स्यति, ससौ, असात्-असासीत्,
सास्यति, सातुं, सित; caus. साययति-ते, desid.
सिषासति; pass. सीयते; the स् of सो is
changed to ष् after prepositions
ending in इ or उ)
1 To kill, destroy.
--2
To finish, complete, bring to an end.
